_comment: Hand-reviewed placements for names whose own filing text places them but no general rule should (#552 COWORK #29). Each entry is an industry from the fixed label list and a PHRASE that must appear verbatim in the filer's stored 10-K Item 1 / 20-F Item 4.B text (data/sec/descriptions.json); scripts/build-sic-classification.mjs takes the quote, form, date and accession from that text and FAILS on a phrase that is not there. No vendor label is read. A name whose text supports no placement is not listed; it stays with the helper. A phrase may also come from the longer excerpt in data/sec/item1-excerpts.json when the display text lacks one (#552 COWORK #37); the basis then says so.
